### Bio

I am a conservation biologist, data scientist, and software developer interested in utilizing spatial data and remote sensing to understand our dynamic ecosystems in the face of climate change.

I apply open-source programming at the National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis, where I am proud to collaborate with passionate conservationists from diverse backgrounds. I process and visualize pan-Arctic datasets derived from machine learning models and satellite imagery for the the [Permafrost Discovery Gateway](https://arcticdata.io/catalog/portals/permafrost) project.

My goal is to provide tools for researchers, community members, and policy makers to answer environmental questions about the Arctic region.
